title: Live Design View
description: Visual Code / Split / Design design view for plain HTML: select, insert and edit elements on the page, style them in a CSS designer, check accessibility (WCAG), links and forms. Every change is written into your real .html and .css files.

title: Odlot Canvas
description: An infinite canvas for connecting your thoughts and ideas — a JSON Canvas 1.0 editor for VS Code.

title: ORCA 6 Helper
description: All-in-one VS Code extension for ORCA 6 quantum chemistry: syntax highlighting, completions, hover docs, diagnostics, output outline TOC, 3D molecular & trajectory visualization, convergence charts, vibrational animations, and IR/UV-Vis spectra.

title: Blueprint Paper
description: A clean paper-and-ink theme inspired by architecture diagrams: crisp slate borders, deep blue accents and a dark console. Light and dark variants.

title: Blyx Oriole
description: Decide whether a scheduled revision can go live after independent review.

title: Blyx Osprey
description: Score a detection against a reference after clipping both to the camera frame.

title: Blyx Pelican
description: Compare per-request aligned I/O with coalesced unaligned reads for a sorted trace.

title: Blyx Petrel
description: Admit an immediate charge or report the wait a request can afford.

title: Blyx Pintail
description: Compare long-only portfolio snapshots under a one-way turnover budget.

title: Blyx Pipit
description: Plan the next CLI batch from child exit codes and a failure allowance.

title: BC Version Switcher
description: Selecciona la versión de Business Central (app.json desde .versions/<VERSION>.app.json) y su caché de símbolos.

title: Claude Code Multi-Account: Shared History
description: A different Claude account in each VS Code window, with one shared history, memory, skills and settings. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic. Never reads login data, makes no network calls.

title: PR Status Panel
description: Live sidebar with checks, review comments and approvals for your open GitHub pull requests, plus a Deployments view showing where each PR is: in main, and which pipeline stages it reached.
